# Templates

Reusable templates for documenting durable decisions, project standards selections, and future project handoffs.

- [ADR template](adr.md)
- [Project standards contract](project-standards.yml)
- [Project agent instructions](project-agent-instructions.md)
- [Project documentation index](project-docs-index.md)
- [Project remediation backlog](project-todo.md)

The project standards contract should record one `compliance.rules` item per assessed rule. Each item should include the rule ID, status, evidence, priority, and next action. `Deferred` and `Exception` items also require rationale; exceptions should include an owner, scope, and compensating control where applicable.
